source: INVENTED FOR DEVELOPMENT. These codes, labels and keywords were written by the build agent so that the categorisation slot in the pipeline has a closed tag set to return. They are NOT the RB-IOS grounds of complaint, they are not derived from any RBI publication, and no complaint may be routed, prioritised or disposed of on the basis of them.
notes: PRD P1-4 categorises against the RB-IOS ground list with a distilled encoder classifier, and names 'RB-IOS ground taxonomy, confirmed and versioned' as a hard dependency that BLOCKS that requirement. Until that list arrives this file stands in so that the interface, the envelope field (DocumentResult.supporting_doc_tags) and the tests exist. Replacing it is a data change: keep the schema, swap taxonomy_id/version/source, set authoritative=true and not_production=false. app.stages.s7_categorise refuses to call itself production while not_production is true.
blocking_dependency: RB-IOS ground taxonomy, confirmed and versioned (PRD hard dependencies, blocks P1-4)
keyword_note: keywords_en are matched on ASCII word boundaries after case folding; keywords_hi are matched as substrings because Devanagari inflection makes a word-boundary match miss the same stem. Both lists are hand-written placeholders, not learned features.

categories.description: PLACEHOLDER. Money debited without the customer's authority: card-not-present fraud, OTP-based fraud, account takeover.
PLACEHOLDER. Account debited at an ATM or cash recycler without cash being paid out, or short payment.

categories.label_en: UPI/IMPS transfer debited but not credited
categories.label_hi: यूपीआई/आईएमपीएस से राशि कटी पर जमा नहीं हुई
categories.description: PLACEHOLDER. Instant-payment transfer where the sender was debited and the beneficiary was not credited, or the reversal did not arrive.

categories.label_hi: डेबिट या क्रेडिट कार्ड संबंधी शिकायत
categories.description: PLACEHOLDER. Card not delivered, blocked without notice, wrong billing, annual fee dispute, EMI conversion not honoured.
PLACEHOLDER. Refusal to open or close an account, unexplained freeze or debit-freeze, KYC re-verification, dormancy, nominee change.
PLACEHOLDER. Fixed or recurring deposit not matured, interest not paid or wrongly computed, premature closure penalty, TDS wrongly deducted.
PLACEHOLDER. Sanction or disbursal delay, wrong interest or penal charge, non-return of title documents, foreclosure charges, NOC not issued.

categories.label_hi: बिना सूचना के लगाए गए शुल्क
categories.description: PLACEHOLDER. Fees or charges debited without prior intimation or contrary to the published schedule of charges.
PLACEHOLDER. Cheque wrongly returned, delayed collection, stop-payment ignored, draft lost, wrong dishonour reason.
PLACEHOLDER. Delay or failure in NEFT, RTGS, inward or outward remittance, wrong beneficiary credit, delayed reversal.
PLACEHOLDER. Net-banking or app access denied, transaction failed in the channel, credentials reset not honoured, standing instruction not executed.

categories.label_hi: अन्य कंपनियों के उत्पादों की गलत बिक्री
categories.description: PLACEHOLDER. Insurance or investment product sold with the account, sold without consent, or sold on a misdescribed benefit.
PLACEHOLDER. Pension credited late, arrears not paid, life-certificate handling, wrong revision.
PLACEHOLDER. Recovery or collection agent contacting outside permitted hours, contacting relatives or employers, intimidation.
PLACEHOLDER. Wrong or stale data reported to a credit information company, closed loan still shown outstanding, correction not carried out.
PLACEHOLDER. Wallet or prepaid card balance not refunded, load failed, closure balance not returned.

categories.label_en: No reply or delayed reply from the bank
categories.label_hi: बैंक से उत्तर न मिलना या विलंब से मिलना
categories.description: PLACEHOLDER. The bank did not reply within the prescribed period, or replied without addressing the grievance; escalation to the Ombudsman on that ground.
